raw_segments.text: Why, the moment the gates of Paradise were open, and he walked in, before he had been
there two seconds, by his watch—though to my thinking his watch must have long dissolved
into its elements on the way—he cried out that those two seconds were worth walking
not a quadrillion kilometres, but a quadrillion of quadrillions, raised to the quadrillionth
In fact, he sang, ha-sena, and overdid it so, that some persons there of lofty ideas
wouldn't shake hands with him at first.
He'd become too rapidly reactionary, they said.
I give it for what it's worth.
So that's the sort of ideas we have on such subjects, even now.
